name: XWUI Notation Diagram
description: One process drawn in a standard notation, as SVG: an ISO 5807 flowchart (terminal, process, decision, call, input/output and store shapes, and loops back into a step such as a retry), swim lanes, a BPMN 2.0 collaboration (an external pool, a pool with two lanes, start and end events, exclusive gateways, boundary errors and data stores) a UML sequence, or a discrete-event simulation model (Arena style: filled create, process, decide and dispose blocks with branch shares, queues of waiting entities and live figures) whose numbered rows can be chosen with the mouse or the keyboard (select event). Colours come from the hue tokens; toSvg() serialises the drawing for export.

className.description: Additional CSS class name for the component

title.description: Spoken name of the drawing; also the BPMN pool name.

steps.description: Steps: { id, name, shape, hue, lane, disabled, error, store }.

edges.description: Connectors: { from, to, label, tone, dashed }.

lanes.description: Lanes or sequence lifelines: { id, name, hue }.

messages.description: Sequence rows: { id, kind, label, lane, reply, failed, retry, hue }.

actor.description: Sequence: the lane of the active actor.

labels.description: Words drawn by the component: alt.

uid.description: Auto-assigned unique instance id (injected by the base component, not user content).
